line: # Pass C, second reader (Opus), 24 Sept 2026. Blind: made from sheets/sheet01-05.jpg (native-resolution line crops, 1.5x and
# 2x enlargements) against atlas/atlas_f29.png, before opening ciphertext.txt, reading*, passA/B or reconciliation.md.
# Codes are the atlas codes. Confidence H = shape clear, M = uncertain. Dots are not counted as signs. 567 signs, 31 M.
# Caveat: the atlas exemplars were cut by aligning the first reader's codes (atlas/dp.py), so this pass shares the first
# reader's sign inventory; it is blind to their transcription, not to their code book.
# N1 = short n, no ascender (L02); first reader: h
# N2 = square bracket [, tall stem with foot and cap (L04 start); first reader: sl
# N3 = small r with a dot (L05); = key nr
# N4 = xi / 3 with a top bar (L05 end, L06); first reader: E
# N5 = two crossed verticals joined by a long bar (L06, L14); first reader: Hb
# N6 = reversed-S hooked right (L07); first reader: 5
# N7 = circled cross under a triangle (L07); first reader: q9
# N8 = cursive H with a diagonal (L12); first reader: Af
# N9 = n with a crossing loop (L14); first reader: no sign
